item.title: Refactor order status into a typed enum
item.brief:
Refactor the `orders` crate order status from String to a public enum.

Requirements:
- Add `src/status.rs` with `pub enum OrderStatus { Pending, Paid, Shipped, Cancelled }`, deriving at least `Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Hash`.
- Implement `OrderStatus::as_str(self) -> &'static str` using exactly `pending`, `paid`, `shipped`, `cancelled`, and `Display` with the same output.
- Implement `FromStr` with `type Err = ParseStatusError`; expose a public `ParseStatusError` implementing `std::error::Error`, with an error message that names the rejected input.
- Implement `can_transition_to(self, next: OrderStatus) -> bool` for exactly pending->paid, pending->cancelled, paid->shipped, paid->cancelled.
- Change `Order::status` to `OrderStatus`, re-export `OrderStatus` and `ParseStatusError` at crate root, and use the enum throughout. Status string literals must appear only in `src/status.rs`.

Preserve all existing observable behavior, including errors, report output and ordering, and parsing. Inspect existing behavior first, then refactor without unintended changes. Add or update tests only as appropriate to verify the specified API and preserved behavior. Run `cargo test` and ensure it passes. Commit the completed work in the assigned worktree; do not push or merge.

Acceptance: implementation satisfies each API and lifecycle requirement; status literals occur only in `src/status.rs`; existing output/errors/parsing semantics and ordering are preserved; `cargo test` passes; commit is created.

stages.summary:
Baseline characterization complete. Structural goal for the next stage: replace Order.status String with public OrderStatus { Pending, Paid, Shipped, Cancelled }, add as_str/Display/FromStr plus public ParseStatusError and can_transition_to, re-export both types, use status literals only in src/status.rs, while preserving all existing behavior. Original baseline is 8da5e05500aaf019c65973e938206f8f8b8cab63; there were no later commits/diffs at stage start. Added only tests/orders.rs characterization tests and committed separately as 3f170d30d84fa924422c333f763904dabe9df5dd. Worktree is clean on assigned branch. Checks before adding tests: CARGO_TARGET_DIR=<assigned cache> cargo test PASS (3 integration tests); cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings PASS; cargo fmt -- --check FAIL due to existing formatting differences in billing.rs, order.rs, report.rs, shipping.rs and the original tests/orders.rs. After adding tests: cargo test PASS (6 tests); strict Clippy PASS; cargo fmt -- --check still fails on those same pre-existing production formatting differences. rustfmt --edition 2021 tests/orders.rs applied only to tests file; git diff --check PASS. Final checked tree: 82677d60847e74ffb68950c988d05e13d3af2ac7.
Public surface inventory: crate root exports Order; public modules billing, order, report, shipping; Order fields id:u32/customer:String/total_cents:u64/status:String and methods new, is_open, cancel()->Result<(),String>; billing::pay/outstanding_cents; shipping::ship/ready_to_ship; report::status_counts/to_line/from_line. Status values are pending, paid, shipped, cancelled. Preserve lifecycle acceptance rules and exact errors (e.g. order N cannot be paid/shipped/cancelled: it is STATUS), is_open true only for pending/paid, report CSV shape id,customer,total_cents,status, BTreeMap lexical status count order, round-trip semantics, parser trim/split behavior and validation order (field count, id, total, then status), exact current error wording including unknown status {:?}. No explicit allowed behavior exceptions were specified; enum and parser API requirements are the structural change.
Characterization now covers lifecycle normal path (pre-existing test), forbidden operations and exact messages, cancellation from pending/paid and refusal from shipped/cancelled, is_open for all states, report count ordering/outstanding/ready-to-ship/to_line/from_line (existing), malformed field count/id/total/status exact errors, validation precedence, and outer whitespace trimming. Gaps: no CLI/wire interfaces exist; no exhaustive direct public enum API tests yet because enum does not exist in baseline; refactorer should add acceptance tests for enum traits/as_str/Display/FromStr/error message/transitions and ensure status literals remain only in src/status.rs. No feedback findings were provided.

Source comparison confirms root exports, lifecycle behavior, parser trim/field validation order, report output and lexical count order are preserved. `rg -n '"(pending|paid|shipped|cancelled)"' src` found all status literals only in `src/status.rs`.
